title: Recover or reconstruct the required forensic image comparator
body:
The original rebuild's image-identity obligation remains unproved. Preserve it as a distinct acceptance item while continuing the independent rendering repair in #44. This issue creates no dependency that pauses #44 and does not complete the active rendering/scientific/release goal.

Evidence from the bounded read-only review at `4bcd987`:

- [Original specification 70d156f](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/70d156f/docs/SPECIFICATION.md), §§1.6, 6(2), 7: preserve pre-rebuild tapes read-only; behaviour-preserving stages must reproduce CPU pixels identically; behaviour-changing stages must record new references with the change named; closure includes comparison against the tapes.
- [8bd56ca](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/8bd56cadb4b1de5fd0f0f016dfec918062fd1b42) explicitly replaces the port's tape-identity gate with semantic/oracle/round-trip evidence. Its [archived review](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/8bd56ca/docs/ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.md#L189-L190) withdraws historical byte-identity claims because no executable consumer existed. Owner authorization for relaxing the original requirement was not recovered; agent/commit prose cannot establish it.
- `b739f92`, `5573155`, `512d596`, and `9cde22e` claim exact Kerr PNG/EXR and Alcubierre PNG comparisons. The inspected evidence contains no checked tape manifest, complete original command/config/environment, compiler/flags/executable identity, comparator, or raw comparison transcript sufficient to reproduce those claims. Neither `1cc9e2a` nor `70d156f` tracks `renders/`; the original baseline directory is absent. The five surviving preview/output files have no recovered provenance linking them to the July tapes.
- [e736ffe](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/e736ffe0c318dcd637f1453beb3523ad14a15047) is a named intentional output change: retry rejected RK45 steps instead of terminating the ray. Its recorded 512×512 Kerr delta is 16.1% of pixels inside the shadow/photon-ring region, with far field and Alcubierre reportedly identical. It identifies regenerated-reference provenance at ignored `renders/rebuild-baseline/README.md`, now absent. The numerical delta is historical prose, not independently recovered comparison evidence.
- Legacy and ported source revisions survive. The starfield is unchanged: Git blob `2e652a5d1ba4ac1c64df640694d7584f30eb8a0f` at `1cc9e2a:src/Sirius.Render/Texture/Starfield.png`, `5573155:assets/Starfield.png`, and current HEAD. SHA-256: `a87d68cb9e9e5ac2be1b7f1d5bdee2a8eabf07639d567643575102f202a1702c`.

Finite repair and acceptance:

1. Search historical sessions/archives for original tapes, recorded hashes, exact scene/config/commands, compiler/build/environment provenance, comparison results, and the missing baseline README. Preserve originals; record recovered provenance and precise unrecoverable gaps.
2. Restore one focused checked manifest and executable comparator for the original CPU cases and relevant behaviour-preserving source transitions. Bind revisions, effective inputs/assets, toolchain/flags and comparison domain; report dimensions, compared samples and exact mismatch counts, and fail on missing/mismatched inputs. A perturbed pixel must fail the exact comparison.
3. If authentic tapes/provenance cannot be recovered, compare explicitly selected legacy and ported revisions under fully declared inputs as **new reconstruction evidence**. Do not call newly generated files recovered originals or certify unobserved historical stages. Keep the remaining original-evidence gap explicit.
4. Preserve the named `e736ffe` reference transition and separately justify later intentional physics/output changes. Do not demand blanket equality between today's corrected physics and the pre-rebuild Kerr image. Do not promote decode/round-trip, statistical, morphology or oracle checks into pixel identity.
5. Keep source and concise findings reviewable in Git, use existing workspace/preset locations, and retain the original full rendering/scientific/platform/release obligations in #44, #48 and #53. This issue's completion proves only its explicitly identified image-comparison scope.

Duplicate check: reviewed all four currently open issues and targeted open searches for forensic, tape, pixel and comparator; none owns this specific lost image-evidence obligation. No source edits, builds, tests or renders were performed for this investigation.
